entries.description: Shell variable that the project .npmrc references for GitHub Packages authentication during installation. Only the variable reference is committed; the value stays in the operator's shell.

Repository or protected-environment secret with read-only access to the DEVAI package. The generated local-RC verifier workflow passes it as NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, fails before installation when it is absent, and never falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN. The post-merge observation workflow, when bound, reuses the same secret.

Optional. The local gh session (keyring login or GH_TOKEN variable) that projects round state onto GitHub issues. Without it tracking sync reports unauthenticated and writes nothing; no other DEVAI effect depends on it.
